Introduction

Yeom Tae-Gyun, also known as Tag, is a South Korean rapper under ARMADA Ent. He is a member of the boy group ONE PACT and a former member of CIIPHER.

In 2021, Tag gained recognition after participating in the fourth season of "High School Rapper." Furthermore, he debuted as the main rapper of the boy group CIIPHER under Rain Company in March of the same year. On August 9, 2023, Rain Company announced that Tag, along with Tan, Won, and Dohwan, had left CIIPHER and the agency after a prolonged period of inactivity.

On October 3, 2023, Armada Entertainment revealed Tag as the Third Member of their upcoming boy group ONE PACT.
